parameters.query:
=WITH payload AS (
  SELECT '{{$json.body_sql}}'::jsonb AS body
), client_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO client_profiles (client_code, client_name, preferred_tone, industry, compliance_notes)
  SELECT body->>'client_code',
         COALESCE(NULLIF(body->>'client_name',''), body->>'client_code'),
         body->>'preferred_tone',
         body->>'industry',
         body->>'compliance_notes'
  FROM payload
  WHERE NULLIF(body->>'client_code','') IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (client_code) DO UPDATE SET
    client_name = EXCLUDED.client_name,
    preferred_tone = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.preferred_tone, client_profiles.preferred_tone),
    industry = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.industry, client_profiles.industry),
    compliance_notes = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.compliance_notes, client_profiles.compliance_notes),
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id
), job_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_jobs (
    external_job_ref, client_profile_id, project_name, brief_text, requested_outputs, status, created_by
  )
  SELECT NULLIF(body->>'external_job_ref',''),
         (SELECT id FROM client_upsert LIMIT 1),
         body->>'project_name',
         body->>'brief_text',
         COALESCE(body->'requested_outputs', '[]'::jsonb),
         'intake_complete'::job_status,
         body->>'created_by'
  FROM payload
  RETURNING id, status
), task_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_tasks (job_id, task_type, task_key, status, input_payload)
  SELECT id, 'intake', 'intake', 'completed', (SELECT body FROM payload)
  FROM job_insert
), event_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_events (job_id, event_type, status_to, message, metadata)
  SELECT id, 'job_created', status, 'Content job created', jsonb_build_object('source','create_content_job')
  FROM job_insert
)
SELECT id::text AS job_id, status::text AS status FROM job_insert;
